clips.hook: If you shot a bullet at ancient armor, could it stop the impact?
clips.caption:
Could ancient armor stop a bullet? 🛡️💥

Chain mail and plate were built for swords and blunt force, and even arrows could get through. A bullet has far more energy.

clips.hook: This bridge is only 11 feet 8 inches tall, and trucks keep hitting it.
clips.caption:
This one bridge has wrecked almost 200 trucks 🚛💥

The 11'8" bridge in Durham, North Carolina sits so low that truck after truck gets its roof peeled off. In 2019 they raised it 8 inches, to 12'4".

Would you have made it under? 👇
